# scripts/mutation-pr.sh starts gremlins once for each changed folder, and sets the limit of the coverage run itself.
# Only gremlins and timeout are stubs. The stub gremlins writes one START line for each start to starts-<case>, and the stub
# timeout writes the limit that it gets to limits-<case>. A START line holds the folder of the start, its path argument
# relative to the repository, GOFLAGS and diff.relative. The report of a start is r-<case>-<folder with _ for />.json,
# and its file names are relative to the folder, as gremlins gives them.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:git] skip
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
env GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
chmod 755 fake/gremlins
chmod 755 fake/timeout
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH

exec git init -q -b main repo
mkdir repo/internal/config/sub
mkdir repo/internal/store/deep
mkdir repo/internal/gone
cp base.go repo/a.go
cp base.go repo/internal/config/host.go
cp base.go repo/internal/config/sub/b.go
cp base.go repo/internal/store/d.go
cp base.go repo/internal/store/deep/e.go
cp base.go repo/internal/gone/g.go
cp gomod repo/go.mod
script mutation-pr.sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
script mutation-exec.sh repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
chmod 755 repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
exec git -C repo add a.go internal go.mod scripts
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base

# Two changed folders, and a folder below one of them: one start for each of the two upper folders, with diff.relative,
# the absolute path of the folder, and the limit of the script as the last -timeout of GOFLAGS. The first start gets the whole limit.
# The reports merge with the folder as a prefix: the lived mutant of the store start is named from the module root.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b two main
cp chg.go repo/internal/config/host.go
cp chg.go repo/internal/config/sub/b.go
cp chg.go repo/internal/store/d.go
exec git -C repo add internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m two
env GREMLINS_CASE=two
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='internal/store/d.go\t3\t5\t4\t0\t\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep -count=2 '^START;' starts-two
grep '^START;internal/config;/internal/config;-count=1 -exec=[^;]*/repo/scripts/mutation-exec\.sh -timeout=1200s;true$' starts-two
grep '^START;internal/store;/internal/store;-count=1 -exec=[^;]*/repo/scripts/mutation-exec\.sh -timeout=1200s;true$' starts-two
grep -count=2 '^[0-9]+$' limits-two
grep '^1200$' limits-two
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=3 killed=2 lived=1 timed_out=0$'
stdout -count=1 '^finding: '
stdout '^finding: internal/store/d\.go:3: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: lived internal/store/d\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=1 printed=1$'

# A changed file in the module root: one start on ".", with no diff.relative and the path ".". Its names are not prefixed.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b root main
cp chg.go repo/a.go
cp chg.go repo/internal/config/host.go
exec git -C repo add a.go internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m root
env GREMLINS_CASE=root
env GREMLINS_RECORDS=
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep -count=1 '^START;' starts-root
grep '^START;\.;\.;-count=1 -exec=[^;]*mutation-exec\.sh -timeout=1200s;$' starts-root
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=2 killed=2 lived=0 timed_out=0$'

# A change in one nested folder: a lived mutant is reported at its path from the module root.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b nested main
cp chg.go repo/internal/store/deep/e.go
exec git -C repo add internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m nested
env GREMLINS_CASE=nested
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='internal/store/deep/e.go\t3\t5\t4\t0\t\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep -count=1 '^START;internal/store/deep;/internal/store/deep;' starts-nested
stdout '^finding: internal/store/deep/e\.go:3: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: lived internal/store/deep/e\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=1 printed=1$'

# The script limit is the last -timeout of GOFLAGS, so it wins over a -timeout of the caller.
env GREMLINS_CASE=caller
env GREMLINS_RECORDS=
env GOFLAGS=-timeout=5m
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^START;internal/store/deep;/internal/store/deep;-timeout=5m -count=1 -exec=[^;]*mutation-exec\.sh -timeout=1200s;true$' starts-caller
env GOFLAGS=

# A folder that the diff deleted is dropped.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b gone main
exec git -C repo rm -q internal/gone/g.go
cp chg.go repo/internal/store/d.go
exec git -C repo add internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m gone
env GREMLINS_CASE=gone
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep -count=1 '^START;' starts-gone
grep '^START;internal/store;' starts-gone

# A diff with no folder left is "no candidate", and gremlins does not start.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b onlygone main
exec git -C repo rm -q internal/gone/g.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m onlygone
env GREMLINS_CASE=onlygone
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: no candidate: the folder of each changed file is gone: internal/gone/g\.go$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'
! exists starts-onlygone

# One deadline for the whole run: the first start uses it up, so the second start does not begin and the message names its folder.
exec git -C repo checkout -q two
env GREMLINS_CASE=late
env GREMLINS_SLEEP=2
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=1
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: the run exceeded MUTATION_TIMEOUT=1s before the start on internal/store$'
! stdout '^mutation-pr: applied='
grep -count=1 '^START;' starts-late
env GREMLINS_SLEEP=
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=

# A start with no report found no mutant in its folder. The other start still gives the result.
env GREMLINS_CASE=half
env GREMLINS_RECORDS=
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep -count=2 '^START;' starts-half
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=1 killed=1 lived=0 timed_out=0$'

# No start wrote a report: the run fails and the message names the folder of each start.
env GREMLINS_CASE=none
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep -count=2 '^START;' starts-none
stdout '^mutation-pr: gremlins wrote no report: it found no mutant in internal/config, internal/store$'
! stdout 'in the module'

# A report that is not JSON fails the run.
env GREMLINS_CASE=bad
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: the gremlins report is not readable$'

-- gomod --
module example.com/r

go 1.27
-- base.go --
package x
-- chg.go --
package x

func F(x int) bool { return x > 0 }
-- fake/gremlins --
#!/bin/sh
prefix=${PWD#"$WORK/repo"}
prefix=${prefix#/}
[ -n "$prefix" ] || prefix=.
for a in "$@"; do last=$a; done
path=${last#"$WORK/repo"}
echo "START;$prefix;$path;$GOFLAGS;$(git config --get diff.relative)" >>"$WORK/starts-$GREMLINS_CASE"
[ -z "${GREMLINS_RECORDS:-}" ] || printf '%b' "$GREMLINS_RECORDS" >>"$MUTATION_EXIT_LOG"
[ -z "${GREMLINS_SLEEP:-}" ] || sleep "$GREMLINS_SLEEP"
report=$WORK/r-$GREMLINS_CASE-$(printf '%s' "$prefix" | tr / _).json
if [ -f "$report" ]; then
	cp "$report" "$5"
fi
-- fake/timeout --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$3" >>"$WORK/limits-$GREMLINS_CASE"
shift 3
exec "$@"
-- r-two-internal_config.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"host.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]},{"file_name":"sub/b.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- r-two-internal_store.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"d.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"LIVED"}]}]}
-- r-root-..json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]},{"file_name":"internal/config/host.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- r-nested-internal_store_deep.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"e.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"LIVED"}]}]}
-- r-caller-internal_store_deep.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"e.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- r-gone-internal_store.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"d.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- r-half-internal_config.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"host.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]},{"file_name":"sub/b.go","mutations":[]}]}
-- r-bad-internal_config.json --
not json
